text:
rachel: quick FYI 1 pushed a small change to the Key details panel in Figma (https://figma.com/snap/key-details-redact). Plan: keep secrets redacted by default, add a timed reveal, and a new "Where used" panel. Looking for quick UX + a11y checks. omar: nice. two quick asks: (1) show last-4 of the secret while redacted for identification, (2) make copy-to-clipboard explicit and show a transient tooltip like "Copied". sam: accessibility notes: when reveal is triggered announce "Secret revealed for 10 seconds" via aria-live (polite). keyboard: reveal control must be reachable and require Enter/Space to confirm (avoid accidental reveals). if user opts to "Keep revealed" we need an extra confirmation and an aria announcement. anika: copy suggestions: reveal button text = "Reveal secret (10s)" tooltip = "Visible for 10 seconds". if "Keep revealed" checked show a subtle banner "Secret visible until hidden". revoke/rotate CTAs should live in the same panel for context. jordan: integration note: the "Where used" panel should list recent services/routes and include "Last used" timestamps and an "Open in logs" action. helpful for triage before you rotate/revoke. omar: agreed 1 and from the panel we should surface inline rotate/revoke actions so support can act without jumping between screens. also show an "impact estimate" line if available. sam: small aria snippet for the reveal toast: ```html
Secret visible for 10s.
``` Programmatically focus the Hide button when the toast appears if the reveal was keyboard-triggered. rachel: edge cases: if user reveals and then navigates away, auto-hide immediately. also record reveal events in audit logs with user + timestamp; surface "last reveal" in admin view. anika: microcopy for redacted state: "•••••••• •••• (last 4: ab12)" and a compact "Where used" link that opens the panel. bulk reveal should be discouraged and require typed-confirm. jordan: UX nit: add a "screen-safe mode" toggle for workspaces where secrets remain redacted even if a user clicks reveal (to support screen-sharing scenarios). rachel: next steps: i'll update the figma with the timed reveal UI, the where-used panel stub, and the copy tweaks. sam, can you add the a11y announce + focus cases to the PR checklist? omar, can you scope the logs link and impact estimate requirements? i'll post updated frames in ~2h. thanks! :sparkles: design-bot: Design review requested by rachel. Reviewers: omar, sam, anika. Deadline: 48h.
